name: Minor Manifestation of Water
summary: Along North Tide's Run, the Minor Manifestation of Water awaits shamans on Silverpine Forest's coast. Its corrupted counterpart must be cleansed before the peaceful spirit can be consulted.

sections.title: A Spirit of the Western Tides
sections.body: The Minor Manifestation of Water waits west of the Sepulcher, along North Tide's Run. For developing shamans, meeting the spirit is an essential rite. Water elementals embody life, renewal, and fluidity, yet malevolent blight can corrupt them. An initiate must face and defeat a corrupted manifestation before the pure spirit reveals itself. Once cleansed, the Minor Manifestation of Water guides shamans on their sacred journey to fashion a Water Totem.

faq.q: Where can I find the Minor Manifestation of Water?
faq.answer: Find the Minor Manifestation of Water along North Tide's Run, on Silverpine Forest's western coast, just west of the Sepulcher.

faq.q: Why is the elemental hostile when I first approach?
faq.answer: A shaman must first summon and destroy the Corrupt Minor Manifestation of Water. After its defeat, the peaceful manifestation appears and speaks with you.
The Minor Manifestation of Water guides shamans in the Call of Water chain, which ultimately teaches them to cast their Water Totem.

faq.q: Can non-shamans interact with this spirit?
faq.answer: The Minor Manifestation of Water guides shamans through their spiritual trials. Other adventurers have little reason to seek the spirit.

angles.text: As a shaman, cleanse the corruption from this elemental and receive its blessing to attune to the tides and forge your Water Totem.
As a troll, orc, or tauren shaman, you travel from Kalimdor to Lordaeron's shores to commune with this spirit.
